name: tudo
description: Tudo: tasks, calendar, alarms, focus timer, habits and clipboard. Web app on Vercel, Android app via Capacitor.

scripts.android:init: npm run build:www && npx cap add android && node scripts/prepare-android.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
